label: Default — the outfitter's dilemma

recentEvents.value: Watched the Glass yesterday: her stitching on his shoulders, kicking in somebody's door.
Sold him greaves anyway. Greaves are not permission to invade another realm; nothing on her shelves is.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Her best customer is the worst thing her craftsmanship has ever been part of.

temporaryObjective.value: Sell him protection and say the tag out loud every time: protection, not permission.

notes: She knows the book is a children's comedy (she stocks a copy) but not the amulet's true nature — to her it is 'that glowing thing' the drills are timed to (profile notes).
